meta.summary: New York Times: hides ad wrappers and the Google sign-in pop-up, blurs or hides story images, can hide summaries, tickers and footer
meta.notes:
**Checked 2026-11-13**, logged out, desktop UA, headless Chrome on https://www.nytimes.com/ (the U.S. home). The iPhone-UA fetch and the article page could not be captured (network dropped during the session), so mobile and article-only markup (paywall gateway, comments, newsletter dialogs) was not inspected and no rules were written for them.

- **Ad wrappers**: `[data-testid="StandardAd"]` matched 5 (the box, the "Advertisement" label and the "Skip advertisement" link); the Google ad iframe inside `#dfp-ad-top` loads in a safeframe (LIVE).
- **Google sign-in prompt**: `#google-one-tap-container` 1 (LIVE).
- **Story images**: `#site-content figure` 79 figures, 76 images (LIVE). Headlines are separate links, so hiding the figure leaves the story.
- **Summaries** `p.summary-class` 35; **market strip** `#masthead-bar-one-widgets` 1; **carousels** `[data-testid="carouselOuterClass"]` 3; **footer** `footer[role="contentinfo"]` 1 and `nav#site-index` 1 (all LIVE).

Not verified: article pages, the subscription gateway and its dialog, mobile layout, the Games and Cooking sections. Class names such as `css-1abc` and `_5zuA3W_listItem` are hashed and are not used; selectors use data-testid, ids, roles and the readable `summary-class`. Data-testid values can change with a site release.
